title: Add a single product to cart successfully
steps: Log in with standard_user and secret_sauce
Verify navigation to the inventory page
Click 'Add to cart' for 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
expectedResult: The 'Add to cart' button changes to 'Remove' and the cart icon badge displays '1'.

title: Add multiple distinct products to cart
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Bike Light'
Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'
expectedResult: All three selected product buttons display 'Remove' and the cart badge increments correctly to '3'.

title: Remove item from cart via inventory page
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
expectedResult: The 'Remove' button reverts back to 'Add to cart' and the cart badge disappears.

title: Cart badge is hidden when no items are in cart
steps: Observe the shopping cart icon at the top right of the inventory page
expectedResult: The cart icon is visible but displays no numeric badge or text when empty.

title: Add all available inventory items to cart
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on all 6 inventory items listed on the page
expectedResult: All 6 item buttons switch to 'Remove' and the cart badge updates to display '6'.

title: Cart badge state persists across page refresh
steps: Click 'Add to cart' on 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
expectedResult: After refresh, 'Sauce Labs Backpack' button remains 'Remove' and cart badge continues to display '1'.

title: Unauthenticated user unable to interact with cart or inventory
steps: Attempt to navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html
expectedResult: User is blocked from accessing the inventory page, redirected back to the login page, and an error message is displayed.

title: Rapid double-clicking on 'Add to cart' button
steps: Rapidly double-click the 'Add to cart' button for 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
expectedResult: The item is added only once, button transitions to 'Remove', and cart badge displays '1' without duplicate counts.
